title: Total Hamming Distance
summary: Calculate the total Hamming distance by summing the differences in corresponding bits for all pairs of integers in the given array.
statement: Calculate the total Hamming distance by summing the differences in corresponding bits for all pairs of integers in the given array.
constraints: 1 <= nums.length <= 10,000; 0 <= nums[i] <= 1,000,000,000; the answer fits a signed 32-bit integer.
Sum Hamming distances over unordered pairs of different indices. Repeated values at different indices remain separate entries.
This is a total over an array, not the two-number Hamming Distance function.
reference_solution:
def total_hamming_distance(nums):
    n=len(nums)
    total=0
    for bit in range(30):
        ones=sum((value>>bit)&1 for value in nums)
        total+=ones*(n-ones)
    return total

hints: Count pair disagreements one bit position at a time.
If a bit has c ones and n-c zeros, it contributes c*(n-c) pairs.
For each of 30 bit positions, count ones and add ones*(n-ones).
Every unordered disagreeing pair selects one member from each group exactly once; no division by two is needed.
editorial: Summing distances over pairs can be reordered into summing disagreements over bits. At one bit, a differing pair contains one one-bit entry and one zero-bit entry. Their group-size product counts unordered pairs directly, including repeated values. The oracle enumerates pairs and compares padded binary strings position by position.
